# MKS’ Atotech to highlight advanced surface finishing solutions for EV battery applications at The Battery Show North America 2026


**Berlin, September 30, 2026 –** MKS Inc. (NASDAQ: MKSI), a global provider of enabling technologies that transform our world, will participate in The Battery Show North America 2026, held October 12–15 at the Huntington Place, Detroit, USA. The event is recognized as North America’s leading gathering for advanced battery and EV technology professionals.


At **booth** **913** , MKS’ Atotech will present its comprehensive portfolio of advanced surface finishing solutions for EV, HEV, and PHEV battery applications, with a focus on sustainability, performance, and manufacturing efficiency. Featured technologies include Cr(VI)-free processes, environmentally responsible adhesion promotion solutions, and advanced treatments for battery enclosures, thermal management systems, current collectors, busbars, connectors, and polymer battery components.


The company’s copper plating technologies help manufacturers address critical challenges in battery production by enabling highly conductive and uniform copper deposits, maintaining excellent adhesion on composite and polymer substrates, and supporting seamless scale-up from development to high-volume manufacturing.


MKS’ Atotech offers integrated process solutions spanning the complete surface finishing workflow, from pretreatment through final sealing. These technologies are designed to enhance battery performance, durability, and sustainability by improving corrosion resistance, conductivity, and adhesion across a wide range of battery components, including terminals, enclosures, laminated aluminum film for pouch cells, and steel housings for cylindrical cells.


Visitors can explore highlights such as:


- Innovative surface treatments for copper foils and busbars
- Corrosion protection for steel and aluminum battery housings
- Advanced solutions for fasteners and battery terminals
- Electromagnetic shielding layers for critical components and polymer battery housings


Featured technologies will include:


**CuFoil PET 2** ‒ Copper plating for enhanced efficiency and safety for composite current collectors, offering exceptional flexibility and optimized conductivity


**CuProtect® XL** ‒ Cr(VI)-free post-treatment, operating at high speed in high current densities with short exposition times


**Argalin® XL** – Cr(VI)-free anti-tarnish, ROHS compatible (CrIII) for silver, copper and nickel-plating processes for busbars and connectors


**Silvertech® RBH** – High wear resistant hard silver-plating process (180 HV)


**UniPrep®** – Long life, low temperature degreasers suitable for steel and aluminum battery components


**Interlox®** – Zirconium-based conversion coatings and passivates for enhanced corrosion protection and paint adhesion


Attendees will have the opportunity to engage with MKS’ Atotech specialists to discuss technical challenges, explore process optimization opportunities, and discover tailored solutions that support battery performance, manufacturing efficiency, and sustainability goals.


**** Visit **booth 913** to learn how MKS’ Atotech’s advanced surface finishing technologies are helping drive the next generation of battery innovation and enabling the future of electric mobility.


**Event:** The Battery Show North America
**Date:** October 12–15, 2026
**Booth:** 913
**Venue:** Huntington Place, Detroit, MI, USA


For more information, please visit[https://www.thebatteryshow.com](https://www.thebatteryshow.com/) . ****
